title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Fifteen thousand Pesos for Forest Reconnaissances in the Philippine Islands.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of fifteen thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, to be expended
under the direction of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources in forest reconnaissances in such
regions as the Director of the Bureau of Forestry may recommend, and in the publication of the result of such
reconnaissances.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 12, 1919.
